plan.title: Fitness Program Results Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of children's performance and participation

panels.title: Total Participants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM baseline UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Child ID") AS n FROM endline

panels.title: Average Shuttle Run Time by Coach
panels.sql: SELECT "Coach", AVG(NULLIF("Shuttle run sec", 0)) AS avg_time FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT "Coach", AVG(NULLIF("Shuttle run sec", 0)) AS avg_time FROM endline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Participation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "DOB") AS month, COUNT(*) AS total FROM baseline GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "DOB") AS month, COUNT(*) AS total FROM endline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 10 Most Improved Children
panels.sql: SELECT "Child name", (NULLIF("endline"."Shuttle run sec", 0) - NULLIF("baseline"."Shuttle run sec", 0)) AS improvement FROM baseline JOIN endline ON baseline."Child ID" = endline."Child ID" ORDER BY improvement ASC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The fitness program has engaged a total of {{p1}} children across various locations. The average shuttle run time, a key performance indicator, varies by coach, with some showing significant improvements in their teams' performance. The monthly participation trend indicates consistent engagement throughout the program duration. Notably, the top 10 most improved children demonstrate the program's effectiveness in enhancing physical fitness.
